judgments.reason: The specification claims commission is applied before payment allowing bids above coins, but the rules state the winner pays the bid, gains the lot, then receives the three-coin commission; nothing in the transcript supports pre-payment commission enabling overbids.
The claim that waiting reveals committed sealed rival bids is contradicted by the rules and transcript which state sealed rival bids should remain private and only resolved bids are normally public.

The specification asserts close can settle with unauctioned lots, but the rule for [close: 1] explicitly says it settles after all three lots are sold; the transcript uses close only after all lots were sold.

The claim that catalog purchases receive the three-coin commission is unsupported: the rules specify the commission is given to the auction winner after paying and catalog items are explicitly not auction wins.
